title: Figure 11: Cloaking Device for Microwaves – split-ring resonator cylinder
description: Color photograph of a microwave cloaking device made of concentric rings of circuit board patterned with split-ring resonators, with enlarged insets of individual resonators. A graph overlaid at top plots material parameter curves (red, yellow and blue lines) against radius in mm. The caption reads "Figure 11. Cloaking Device for Microwaves."
